title: The Role of cGAS-STING-Driven PANoptosis in Neurodegenerative Diseases and Therapeutic Prospects.
snippet: Neurodegenerative diseases share features of neuronal loss, neuroinflammation, and protein aggregation. The cGAS-STING pathway, a key DNA sensor, mediates neuroinflammation via TBK1-IRF3 and IKK-NF-κB axes, inducing type I interferons and pro-inflammatory cytokines. This pathway upregulates ZBP1, promotes PANoptosome assembly, and triggers PANoptosis,...
